summary.text: Roy Adams is a Democratic member of the Louisiana House of Representatives, representing District 62 (East Baton Rouge and East Feliciana parishes), and was elected in 2019, according to the official House member page.

paragraphs.text: The member page lists Roy Adams's occupation as Self Employed - Adams Enterprises; Independent Contractor - The Capital City Press.
It lists education as Jackson High School; Southwest Mississippi College; Northeastern University in Monroe, LA.

The page lists committee assignments including Administration of Criminal Justice, Appropriations, Retirement and the Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget, and caucus affiliations including the Capital Region Legislative Delegation, the Democratic Caucus and the Louisiana Rural Caucus.
